normalization_population.required: Full eligible 2023 positional CFBD populations, filters and producer version.
normalization_population.observed_access: Unauthenticated CFBD 2023 receiving request returned HTTP 401; no API key in this execution environment.
normalization_population.effect: No qualified normalized production score or Rookie Alpha grade is emitted. Manual legacy scores are not repaired by changing their source text.

draft_handoff.note: Data has no inspected canonical 2024 draft-results handoff. Census facts are a separate candidate, not a replacement runtime file.

source_conflicts.note: The March 2024 recap uses 905 in the career table but 906 elsewhere. Current school roster and April 2024 school draft release use 906. This one-yard conflict remains explicit and blocks unqualified normalization.

identity_notes: Primary school names are preserved: Southern California corresponds to legacy USC.
Local IDs are proposed identity keys, not Data-admitted canonical identities.
The NFL factbook prints Ja'Lynn Polk in round 1 despite overall pick 37; secondary draft round 2 is adopted explicitly.
Sione Vaki is an NFL-drafted RB; his secondary CSV position is empty, so filtering that CSV alone undercounts the domain.
